text: This report recommends a Heavy Vehicles Prohibition to prohibit trucks at all times on Pharmacy Avenue between Ellesmere Road and Eglinton Avenue East. Currently, trucks are prohibited on this section of Pharmacy Avenue from 7:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. nightly.

City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council amend the existing heavy vehicles prohibition in effect from 7:00 p.m. of one day to 7:00 a.m. of the next following day on Pharmacy Avenue, between Ellesmere Road and Eglinton Avenue East, to be in effect at all times.
